title: Состав смесей солей по потере массы
prompt:
Each sample below is a mixture of exactly two compounds. Every sample is heated strongly until its mass no longer changes. On heating the compounds behave as follows (water vapour and carbon dioxide escape completely; the solid products shown are stable and remain in the residue; nothing else happens):
  NaHCO3: 2 NaHCO3 → Na2CO3 + H2O + CO2
  CaCO3: CaCO3 → CaO + CO2
  ZnCO3: ZnCO3 → ZnO + CO2
  Na2CO3·10H2O: Na2CO3·10H2O → Na2CO3 + 10 H2O
  NaCl: NaCl does not change
  K2CO3: K2CO3 does not change

Atomic masses: H = 1.008, C = 12.011, O = 15.999, Na = 22.990, Cl = 35.45, K = 39.098, Ca = 40.078, Zn = 65.38.

Samples (initial mass of the mixture; mass of the solid residue after heating):
1. 22.28 g of a mixture of ZnCO3 and NaCl; mass of the residue 17.98 g.
2. 14.18 g of a mixture of NaHCO3 and NaCl; mass of the residue 9.94 g.
3. 25.72 g of a mixture of CaCO3 and K2CO3; mass of the residue 21.99 g.
4. 18.68 g of a mixture of Na2CO3·10H2O and NaHCO3; mass of the residue 10.32 g.
5. 9.70 g of a mixture of CaCO3 and NaCl; mass of the residue 8.16 g.

For each sample, find the mass percentage of the FIRST-named compound in the original mixture. Use the atomic masses above and keep at least 5 significant figures in intermediate results. Give the 5 percentages rounded to 1 decimal place, separated by commas, in the order of the samples.

Think it through, then finish with a final line of the form `ANSWER: <your answer>`.

title: Диффи–Хеллман: общий ключ через дискретный логарифм
prompt:
Alice and Bob run a textbook Diffie–Hellman key exchange with the public prime p = 701 and the public generator g = 3 (a primitive root modulo p). Alice picks a secret exponent a and publishes A = g^a mod p = 288; Bob picks a secret exponent b and publishes B = g^b mod p = 202 (1 ≤ a, b ≤ p − 2). The shared secret is K = g^(a·b) mod p = B^a mod p = A^b mod p.

Recover the shared secret K (you will need to find one of the secret exponents, e.g. by computing successive powers of g modulo p). Give K as an integer between 0 and p − 1.

Think it through, then finish with a final line of the form `ANSWER: <your answer>`.

title: Отбор в однолокусной модели
prompt:
A diploid population has one locus with two alleles, A and a. Genotype fitnesses (relative viabilities) are w(AA) = 0.70, w(Aa) = 0.80, w(aa) = 0.95. If p is the frequency of A in one generation, the frequency in the next generation is

  p' = (p²·w(AA) + p·q·w(Aa)) / (p²·w(AA) + 2·p·q·w(Aa) + q²·w(aa)),  where q = 1 − p.

The initial frequency is p₀ = 0.88. Rounding rule: after computing each generation, round p' to 4 decimal places (round half up) and use this rounded value for the next generation.
